entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
He has sought his release
on short term bail on the ground of illness of his daughter.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the daughter of the applicant is suffering with Hernia and she has been referred to Higher Centre by the doctors of Moradabad.
4. When the matter taken up on the last occasion, the Court had required the applicant to file the investigating report of the patient.
It has not been filed.
5. Now, along with the supplementary affidavit, a referral slip has been placed, by which, patient has been referred to Safdarjung Medical College, New Delhi for expert opinion 6.
Without any investigation, how a patient has been referred from Moradabad to a particular hospital in New Delhi?
There is no reason for it.
Can not surgery like Hernia may be conducted in Moradabad?

7. Having considered, this Court does not see any ground to enlarge the applicant on short term bail Abdul Rehman vs State Of Uttarakhand on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178649278/
1 and the short term bail application of the applicant deserves to be rejected.
8.
